name: 墨韵
description: 纯黑 #000000 强调，Georgia 衬线体，极简黑白灰，适合深度长文、文学评论、严肃写作

styles.h1: font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: #000000; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -0.02em; border-bottom: 2px solid #000000; margin-top: 36px; margin-bottom: 18px;
styles.h2: font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #111111; line-height: 1.45; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 3px solid #000000; margin-top: 34px; margin-bottom: 18px;
styles.h3: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #222222; line-height: 1.45; padding-bottom: 6px; margin-top: 28px; margin-bottom: 14px;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #111111; line-height: 1.8; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 20px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote: border-left: 3px solid #000000; background: #fafafa; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; border-radius: 0; font-size: 16px; color: #333333; line-height: 1.8;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 14px; color: #111111; line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: 0; background: transparent; letter-spacing: 0.3px;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; border-radius: 2px; display: block; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); background: #ffffff; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px;
styles.hr: margin-top: 38px; margin-bottom: 38px; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,0,0,0) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.88) 28%, rgba(0,0,0,0.88) 72%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 100%); border: none; width: 34%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;
styles.code: background: #f0f0f0; border-radius: 2px; font-size: 13px; color: #000000; font-family: 'SF Mono', Consolas, monospace;
styles.pre: background: #f5f5f5; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #e0e0e0; color: #000000; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word; word-break: break-all;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; background: #e8e8e8;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #000000; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'SF Mono', Consolas, monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 24px; font-size: 15px; border-spacing: 0; border-radius: 0; overflow: hidden;
styles.th: background: #f5f5f5; border: 1px solid #cccccc; text-align: left; font-weight: 700; color: #000000;
styles.ol li::marker: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; min-width: 22px; background: #f0f0f0; color: #000000; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; margin-right: 10px; margin-top: 4px; border: 1px solid #cccccc;
styles.li: font-size: 16px; color: #111111; line-height: 1.8; letter-spacing: 0.5px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 8px; align-items: flex-start;
styles.footnotes li: font-size: 13px; color: #999999; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; word-break: break-all;
styles.h4: font-size: 19px; font-weight: bold; color: #222222; border-left: 2px solid #000000; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h5: font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; color: #555555; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h6: font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; color: #888888; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.3;
